stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in GSE74570: the sequenced groups differ only by Nampt genotype (WT/KO/OE) and age (4/7/24 months). Exercise was a phenotypic test applied to all mice (treatment_protocol_ch1), not a sequenced factor, so the requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable. Running genotype or age contrasts and calling them exercise effects would misrepresent the study.
